I invited my friends, one of whom is lesbian and the other who's straight, to spend Thanksgiving with my family. My lesbian friend politely declined as they have plans with their family, who's always together for the holidays. The straight friend, though, does not have a good relationship with their parents at all and so they readily accepted our invitation. Which friend has family problems?
A. Unknown
B. The lesbian friend
C. The straight friend
